title: Passing on the Move Relay
description: Partners push down the court together while passing back and forth, the demanding coordination of catching, passing and pushing all at once.

content.objective: Pass accurately while both players keep pushing, without either chair slowing down.
content.setup: Partners push side by side down the full length of the court, one ball between them.
instructions: Push together at a steady pace, staying level with each other.
Pass back and forth every few pushes, never holding the ball for long.
Lead every pass slightly ahead of the receiver's push direction.
Finish with a shot at the far basket once close enough.
coachingPoints: Lead the pass to where the partner is going, not where they are.
Keep passing on the move rather than stopping to pass.
Stay level with the partner so the passing lane stays open.
commonMistakes: Slowing down or stopping just to make the pass easier.
Passing behind the partner's current position instead of ahead of it.
Catching with the chair still turning instead of squared up first.
content.safety: Make sure the full-court lane is clear before pushing at pace.
